name: @gitwebui/desktop
author: GitWebUI
//: Deliberately no "type" field. Electron's main process and (especially) a sandboxed preload want CommonJS, and the esbuild bundle emits CJS.

The electron version is pinned rather than a range: electron-builder downloads platform binaries for one exact release, and with npm workspace hoisting it cannot resolve a range from desktop/node_modules.

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
